messages:
maya: quick sync — thinking through validation UX for Console > Model Pins. options: inline badges, floating summary bar, or top-summary + inline anchors. also required labeling and delete confirmations. attaching tiny artboards. dan: can you drop the mobile frames here? curious how the bar behaves on small screens. maya: pasted. floating summary bar would dock to top on desktop, collapse on mobile; anchors still apply. sophia: i like top-summary + inline anchors for accessibility. alternative 'floating bar' could work if it's a real live region (role="status") and keyboard reachable. ensure focus moves to it on submit failure. oliver: prefer explicit text 'Required' after labels over symbols. also propose showing a subtle badge next to label (e.g., "Required") for scan ability. marco: on deletes: propose typed confirm for irreversible actions or when removing >5 pins. for single quick deletes keep modal with clear primary/secondary actions. maya: why 5? we use 5 as a threshold because bulk pins often indicate admin intent. open to changing. dan: accessibility items: invalid inputs should have aria-invalid="true" and aria-describedby pointing to inline message id. for the summary, use aria-live and role="alert" or role="status" depending on verbosity. a11y-bot: Tip: WCAG advises more than color. make required visible via text and ensure error outlines meet contrast guidelines. also ensure focus indicators persist on click. sophia: UX rule idea: if error count >4 show expanded summary and a short 'jump to first' link. otherwise keep summary collapsed to reduce visual noise. oliver: interaction: clicking summary items must call element.focus() and expose visible focus. log data-error-bucket and data-error-id for analytics. marco: server side validation should map keys to field anchors; for unknown server errors, show a persistent banner with retry and contact support link. avoid clearing user inputs on server fail. maya: copy tweak: use softer header like 'We need a couple quick fixes' or 'Please fix these fields to continue'. prefer the latter for clarity. for typed confirm: 'Type DELETE to permanently remove.' short and explicit. dan: mobile behaviour: floating bar collapses into a compact pill with error count; tapping it expands to the list and options to jump to fields. auto-scroll to first error when opened. sophia: can you share a small markup snippet for the floating bar pattern? i'll run an a11y pass. maya: snippet i plan to include:
  • Pin name required
oliver: looks good. include focus management notes and mobile collapse behaviour. maya: consensus leaning: top-summary + inline anchors as primary pattern, floating bar as compact variant on long pages, explicit 'Required' text, typed confirms for >5 irreversible deletes, aria attributes and contrast checks. i'll update figma and the spec in ~30m.
